reason: I already make my own syrups and rhums arrangés in-house for a few euros a litre, so at 23 euros HT a litre I'd ask for the free samples and maybe put it on as a péi touch later, but I won't order this month. The quarterly cost review would flag it straight away next to my house syrups.
objection: 23 euros a litre is two to three times what my homemade syrups or a Monin cost me, and on top of that I have to manage returning deposit bottles, which my team will forget.
would_change_my_mind: Tasting the sample and finding a flavour I genuinely can't make myself, priced closer to 15 euros HT, with the deposit bottles picked up at delivery without me having to track them.
